## Wheelhouse 7.0 release notes

- Added saved search alerts by email and push notification
- New VIN lookup with accident history report
- Dealer inventory sync via CSV and API feed
- Price drop badges on listings
- Financing pre-qualification without a credit score hit
- Virtual 360 degree photo tours
- Messaging between buyers and sellers inside the app
- Verified dealer badge on dealership profiles
copy:
Subject: Wheelhouse 7.0 is here

Finding the right used car just got easier. Save any search and we will alert you by email or push notification the minute a matching car is listed, so you never miss a deal. Paste a VIN and see the accident history report before you drive across town. Dealers can now sync their inventory through a CSV or an API feed, which saves hours of manual uploads. Every listing shows a price drop badge when the seller lowers the price, so you can spot a bargain instantly. See if you qualify for financing without a credit score hit, so you can shop with confidence. Chat with sellers directly inside the app. Look for the verified dealer badge on dealership profiles.
